task.title: Quickstart — Accept Your First PayPal Payment
task.shortdesc: Create a sandbox order and capture a payment end-to-end in under 15 minutes using the PayPal REST API and curl.

ul.li: A PayPal Developer account — sign up at developer.paypal.com
Sandbox client_id and client_secret from the Developer Dashboard

step.cmd: Log in to the PayPal Developer Dashboard and create a sandbox app.
step.info: Navigate to My Apps & Credentials → Sandbox → Create App. Copy the client_id and client_secret.

step.stepresult: Response contains access_token valid for 32400 seconds (9 hours).

step.cmd: Create a payment order for $10.00 USD.
step.stepresult: Response returns an id (e.g., 5O190127TN364715T) and status CREATED.

step.cmd: Redirect the buyer to the PayPal approval URL from the response links.
step.info: Parse the links array for rel: "approve" and redirect the buyer's browser to that URL.
step.stepresult: The buyer logs in to PayPal and approves the payment. PayPal redirects back to your return_url.

step.cmd: Capture the approved order to collect funds.
step.stepresult: Status changes to COMPLETED. Funds are collected.

result.p: Your first PayPal payment is complete. The order id can be used to issue refunds or retrieve transaction details.

postreq.p: See for full token management, or for advanced order options.
